319.instruction: Turn around to face the sliding doors. Walk straight through the door until you see steps. Walk up to the top of the steps. Stand on the next floor up.

7156.instruction: Walk through the door, down the hall and start downstairs. Stop near the top of the stairs.

7360.instruction: Go inside. Turn right and go past table. Go past cabinet with sink. Stop at hallway.
